Read our cookie policy for more details.DeclineCustomizeAccept AllInMobiConsumer BrandsGlance1WeatherEnterprise PlatformsInMobi AdvertisingCompanyLeadershipCultureInMobi Advertising PressGlance PressInMobi Advertising CareersGlance CareersTrust CenterLife At InMobiWe Are Builders, Dreamers, DoersOur culture celebrates possibility.We encourage every InMobian to question, reimagine, and build things that move the world forward.Here, high performance meets deep care. Ambition meets trust. Excellence meets impact.We Win When Our People DoOur recognitions are milestones of what our people achieve together. By putting our people first, we’ve built a culture that’s not just award winning but genuinely worth celebrating.Fast CompanyWorld's Most Innovative Companies2018CNBCDisruptor 50 list2019Great Place to Work™India's Best Companies to Work For2020Our Values Are Our Way Of LifeWe’ve anchored our values in the elements of life itself.Four forces of nature. Four ways of being. Each one a part of us.MindsetPeopleExecutionEnvironmentOUR MINDSETWaterThinking Big. Being Entrepreneurial.We think like water - bold, fluid, and limitless. We move with Intent. We shape what doesn’t yet exist. We ask why not? Take smart risks and carve our own paths. We flow forward with phenomenal execution.OUR PEOPLEFireBeing Passionate. Fanatically Driven. Being Proud.We carry fire within us. We care deeply, obsess over progress. That care becomes craft. That obsession becomes momentum. We move fast. Build boldly. And take pride in what we create. We are the energy.OUR EXECUTIONEarthBeing Positive, Taking Ownership, Being Accountable.We are steady, grounded, and relentless. We own it. when things go right, especially when they don’t. We take accountability seriously. Wins, misses, gaps - they’re all ours to hold, and to fix, together. And through all of it, we choose belief.OUR ENVIRONMENTAirEnjoying Freedom with Responsibility and Integrity.Freedom and trust is our default. Matched by responsibility and doing what's right - even when no one’s watching. A promise we all uphold. To keep the air clean. To protect the culture. To create space to feel safe, respected, and free to be our best. This is the climate we co-create. This is what makes everything possible.Programs That Power Our PeopleOur programs make every day at InMobi meaningful, helping you connect, celebrate, and learn together.RecognitionFrom the InMobi Emmys to Ring the Bell wins, we celebrate bold ideas, everyday impact, and the people who power our innovation.Growth & LearningFrom Bridge Assignments for cross-functional learning to Encore, our global tech community, we learn by doing, experimenting, and exchanging ideas with the best in the ecosystem.Clubs & CommunitiesBecause you bring your whole self to work: the builder, the artist, the athlete, the cinema lover, and we make space for all of it.Global ConnectFrom The Hour town halls to regular cultural celebrations, we stay connected across offices and time zones, growing as one global InMobi community.Hear From The People Powering InMobiOur people make the extraordinary feel everyday.Watch Now"InMobi has an open working environment which is innovative, young and without many layers. I am surrounded by open minded and positive people, who are super collaborative!"Ling JinSales Team"I am impressed with the technology, product offerings, the leadership team, people honesty and the smooth interview process. Working with colleagues who are smart, friendly and fun to work with, I see myself making lifetime friends here!"Crisna HaiSales TeamWhere We Work, Connect, And BelongWe’re a global company with local heartbeats, spanning offices in Bengaluru, Singapore, New York, San Francisco, London, Tokyo, and more. Read our cookie policy for more details.DeclineCustomizeAccept AllInMobiConsumer BrandsGlance1WeatherEnterprise PlatformsInMobi AdvertisingCompanyLeadershipCultureInMobi Advertising PressGlance PressInMobi Advertising CareersGlance CareersTrust CenterLeadership - Naveen TewariNaveen TewariFounder & Chief Executive Officer, InMobi & GlanceNaveen Tewari is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of InMobi & Glance.He is widely recognized for pioneering India’s technology and startup ecosystem and for positioning the nation on the global innovation map. Since founding InMobi in 2007, Naveen has been at the forefront of digital advertising and, later, AI-driven commerce through Glance, the intelligent shopping agent, becoming India’s biggest foray into AI. Under his leadership, InMobi became India’s first unicorn in 2011, marking a defining moment in the nation’s startup journey. He later achieved another milestone by building Glance, becoming the first Indian entrepreneur to create two unicorns. Today, InMobi has evolved into a global leader in digital advertising, while Glance is transforming the way the world will shop in the future using AI. He is an alumnus of IIT Kanpur, where he received the Distinguished Alumni Award, and of Harvard Business School. Naveen has received several honours, including the Future Leaders Award from the Honourable Prime Minister of India and the Uttar Pradesh Gaurav Samman. Beyond his entrepreneurial achievements, Naveen remains a passionate mentor and an inspiration to India’s next generation of innovators and entrepreneurs. Abhay drives the company’s global business, enabling the world's leading brands to reach over 1.3 billion people in over 190 countries. Prior to his current role as CEO, he held several different executive positions within InMobi including Chief Revenue Officer and Head of Human Resources. Abhay was recognized as one of India's most influential and impactful young business leaders by the Economic Times 40-Under-Forty in 2018. During his time as CRO, Abhay drove record revenue growth globally across China, APAC and the U.S. markets, helping InMobi be recognized as one of the 50 most disruptive companies by both CNBC and MIT Technology Review. Abhay received his Bachelor’s degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur (IIT). He is based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Read our cookie policy for more details.DeclineCustomizeAccept AllInMobiConsumer BrandsGlance1WeatherEnterprise PlatformsInMobi AdvertisingCompanyLeadershipCultureInMobi Advertising PressGlance PressInMobi Advertising CareersGlance CareersTrust CenterLeadership - Piyush ShahPiyush ShahCo-Founder, InMobi & GlancePiyush is a Co-founder at InMobi, and President & COO at Glance, an AI-driven lock screen platform. Glance has redefined the way users discover content and commerce on the internet and is one of Asia’s fastest growing platforms.Piyush plays an integral role in driving the overall vision, strategy, and execution that makes Glance the most ubiquitous lock screen platform in the world. Glance has pioneered personalized, AI-driven content, live entertainment commerce, and gaming on the lock screen, making it a place where users experience the best of the internet without searching, downloading any apps, or even unlocking their phones. Previously, he spearheaded building InMobi Marketing Cloud into a world-class product organization by leading the product and user experience teams as Chief Product Officer. He also led InMobi's performance advertising business, developer platforms initiatives and TruFactor from 0 to 1. In 2017, Piyush was recognized as one of the 40 hottest young business leaders under 40 in India by The Economic Times, one of the country’s biggest financial dailies. Piyush has been a passionate entrepreneur since the age of 19 when he began his very first venture in the education space, for which he was recognized by Business World magazine as one of India’s Innovative Youth Entrepreneurs. Prior to his tenure at InMobi and Glance, Piyush worked at Deutsche Bank and Citigroup. Currently, he is an active investor for 20+ startups, focused on new-age enterprise SaaS, India-focused consumer tech, EdTech, and the HealthTech space. He envisions making India the global destination for visionary entrepreneurship. Piyush has long been a mentor in the startup community. Not only has he been a driving force in achieving great business results, but also in growing the Indian startup ecosystem sustainably, ensuring innovative ambitions result in fuller, more meaningful lives for all. Piyush has an MBA in Strategy and Marketing from the prestigious Indian School of Business (ISB), and a Bachelors in Engineering from Delhi College of Engineering.
